stem: The team refused to ______ the plan despite the delays.
explanation: abandon 意为“放弃”，与 despite the delays 的转折语义吻合；absorb 吸收、analyze 分析、achieve 实现（语义相反）。

stem: Plants ______ water through their roots.
explanation: absorb 吸收，植物通过根“吸收”水分；encourage 鼓励、establish 建立、influence 影响，均不合语境。

stem: Make sure the numbers are ______ before you submit the report.
explanation: accurate 准确的；提交报告前要确保数字“准确”。curious 好奇的、familiar 熟悉的、available 可获得的。

stem: It took him weeks to ______ to the cold weather.
explanation: adapt to 适应；adopt（采纳）是及物动词，不接 to；本题为形近词辨析。

stem: Speaking slowly is an ______ way to help beginners.
explanation: an 后需接元音开头的形容词作定语：effective 有效的；effort/evidence 是名词，establish 是动词。

stem: Don't ______ that everyone knows the rules.
explanation: assume 想当然地认为，后接 that 从句；assess 评估、assign 分派、assist 协助。

stem: Regular review ______ long-term memory.
explanation: 主语 review 为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语加 -s：benefits；beneficial 是形容词不能作谓语。

stem: Learning a language well is a big ______, but it is worth it.
explanation: challenge 挑战；a big challenge 为常见搭配。change 变化、chance 机会、charge 收费。

stem: She ______ herself to daily practice last year.
explanation: commit oneself to（doing）sth. 承诺投入，to 为介词；其余动词不与 herself to 搭配。

stem: Please ______ all the options before making a decision.
explanation: consider 考虑；“考虑所有选项”用 consider。contact 联系、contain 包含、control 控制。

stem: He ______ a lot to the team's success.
explanation: contribute to 为……做出贡献，固定搭配；attract 吸引、distribute 分发、substitute 替代。

stem: Children are naturally ______ about the world.
explanation: be curious about 对……好奇，固定搭配；其余为形近词干扰项。

stem: After hours of discussion, they finally made a ______.
explanation: make a decision 做决定，固定搭配；decade 十年、decline 下降、degree 程度。

stem: Reading every day helps ______ your vocabulary.
explanation: develop（逐渐）培养、扩充，develop vocabulary 扩充词汇量；deliver 递送、describe 描述、design 设计。

stem: Short daily practice is more ______ than one long session a week.
explanation: effective 有效的，比较级 more effective；其余语义不合。

stem: Success favors people who put in consistent ______.
explanation: put in effort 付出努力；形近词辨析：error 错误、event 事件、effect 影响。

stem: Teachers should ______ students to ask questions.
explanation: encourage sb. to do 鼓励某人做某事；discourage 意为“使气馁”，与句意相反。

stem: The university was ______ in 1898.
explanation: be established 被建立、创立，与年份搭配；其余动词不与机构+年份搭配。

stem: There is growing ______ that sleep affects learning.
explanation: growing evidence that... 越来越多的证据表明，that 从句为同位语从句。

stem: His name looks ______, but I can't remember where we met.
explanation: look familiar 看起来眼熟；favourite 最喜欢的、famous 著名的、fancy 花哨的。

stem: First ______ on high-frequency words, then broaden your range.
explanation: focus on 聚焦于，祈使句用动词原形；fold 折叠、find 找到、fix 修理。

stem: Break a big ______ into smaller, measurable steps.
explanation: goal 目标；拆分目标符合语境。game 游戏、gate 大门、gift 礼物。

stem: Recording your voice helps you ______ your pronunciation.
explanation: improve 改进，improve pronunciation 改进发音；imply 暗示、import 进口、impress 留下印象。

stem: The media has a strong ______ on public opinion.
explanation: have an influence on 对……有影响，固定搭配；其余为形近词干扰项。

stem: It is easier to ______ a habit than to build one.
explanation: maintain 维持；与 build（养成）对照。obtain 获得、contain 容纳、entertain 娱乐。

stem: A good ______ turns limited time into real progress.
explanation: strategy 策略；好的策略把有限时间变成真实进步。station 车站、statistics 统计、standard 标准。

stem: She said she ______ the movie before, so she didn't join us.
explanation: “看电影”发生在“没加入我们”（过去）之前，即“过去的过去”，用过去完成时 had seen。

stem: If it ______ tomorrow, the match will be canceled.
explanation: 真实条件句：主句用将来时，if 从句用一般现在时（主将从现）。

stem: He is the engineer ______ designed the bridge.
explanation: 先行词是“人”且关系词在定语从句中作主语，用 who；which 指物、whose 表所属、whom 作宾语。

stem: By the end of this year, she ______ English for ten years.
explanation: by + 将来时间点，且 for ten years 表持续到将来，用将来完成时 will have learned。
